question:
I have some models to run in specific times such as run:hourly, run:every_10_min, and so on. Also, I have a standard time when I run all models, except those with the above-mentioned tags. I tried to do this running the following command:

dbt build --exclude tag:run*

The idea is to cover all tags with start with run, but it didn't work, and all models were called by DBT.

How to do this?
title: DBT: run all models but the selected tag by regex
answer:
I would recommend adding tag:run_all to use it when you need to run all of them.

Another approach can be moving all these models into the same folder and running them using path rather than tag.
